plugins.name: 10x-engineer

plugins.name: codex-loop-engineering
plugins.description: Repo-first Codex loop execution, handoff, tracker, and verified continuation management for long-running work across projects.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Mission-control orchestration for Claude Code — one coordinator session brainstorms each ask, then launches ONE autonomous headless session per mission that plans, executes, and self-reviews in guarded git worktrees; the coordinator stays free for other work, mediates blocked questions, and does light acceptance + merge. All state lives on disk in a .orchestrator/ hub so any fresh session can resume.
